name: La Quercia
source:
A tragic accident has occurred. In the village of Sant'Angelo and old oak tree has fallen over and crushed the lady of the estates Filippa Lombardi. Olivia Lombardi, the long lost daughter of the victim, returns for the funeral of her estranged mother. But Olivia doesn't believe that it was an accident.

A detective game about intrigue,  family,  acceptance and the memories of an oak tree.

Made during the Global Game Jam 2023, the theme was "Roots".

[From [url=https://ringdinglinn.itch.io/la-quercia]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一场惨剧发生了。圣安杰洛村的一棵老橡树倒下，砸死了庄园女主人菲莉帕·隆巴尔迪。与母亲疏远多年的女儿奥莉维娅·隆巴尔迪返乡参加葬礼，但她并不相信这是一场意外。

一款关于阴谋、家庭、接纳，以及一棵橡树的记忆的侦探游戏。

本作制作于2023年Global Game Jam，主题为“根”。

[摘自[url=https://ringdinglinn.itch.io/la-quercia]Itch.io[/url]]
